title: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems
title_zh: OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger

paragraphs.en: Reality may establish that an outcome occurred without identifying which evolving procedure produced it or why. This distinction matters in production ML systems whose code, configuration, and artifacts change while external feedback accumulates. We examine it in a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, using oracle to mean an external source of realized outcomes rather than a complete correctness specification.
paragraphs.zh: 现实可能表明某个结果已经发生，却无法确定是哪一个演化过程产生了它，也无法说明其发生的原因。 在生成式机器学习系统中，这种区别至关重要，因为这类系统的代码、配置和产物会随着外部反馈的积累而发生变化。 我们在一个由人类主导、由智能体构建的量化交易系统中对此进行了研究，其中“神谕”指的是实现结果的外部来源，而非完整的正确性规范。

sents.en: We examine it in a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, using oracle to mean an external source of realized outcomes rather than a complete correctness specification.

paragraphs.en: Across one year, the account gained and outperformed a broad market index, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification. Retrospectively selected subperiods include adverse relative performance and conditional candidate-level weakness under declared approximate references. Engineering records document changes during the episode, and complete recommendation-to-runtime binding is unavailable. The archive does not establish a common frozen instance or a unique cause.
paragraphs.zh: 在一年期间，该账户实现了增长并跑赢了广泛的市场指数，但在主要回顾性设定下，年度阿尔法值在统计上无法与零区分。 回顾性选择的子周期包括相对表现不佳的情况，以及在已声明的近似参考标准下的条件性候选级弱势。 工程记录记载了事件期间的变更，但完整的从推荐到运行时的绑定关系并不可用。 该档案并未确立一个共同的冻结实例或唯一的原因。

paragraphs.en: The case motivates an outcome–diagnosis gap : outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation support distinct claims. We distinguish frozen instances, pre-specified adaptive procedures, and ad-hoc development; organize archive-relative claim identifiability and an evidence hierarchy; and propose a prospective production-binding protocol. An illustrative compatible-history example shows how factual binding can resolve a recommendation’s referent without supplying its counterfactual effect. The protocol is proposed rather than prospectively validated. External feedback constrains outcome claims, while provenance and additional identification structure determine the resolution of diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 该案例揭示了一个结果与诊断之间的差距：结果证据、评估对象的身份以及因果解释各自支持不同的主张。 我们区分了固定实例、预先指定的自适应程序以及临时开发方法；组织了与档案相关的可识别性主张和证据层级；并提出了一个前瞻性的生产绑定协议。 一个兼容历史的示例表明，事实绑定如何能够在不提供反事实效应的前提下，明确推荐项的指代对象。 该协议是作为提案提出的，而非经过前瞻性验证的。 外部反馈对结果主张构成约束，而来源和额外的识别结构则决定了诊断的解决方式。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: agent-engineered systems; production ML; provenance; fault diagnosis; prequential evaluation; quantitative trading.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：智能体构建的系统；生产级机器学习；来源追溯；故障诊断；预序评估；量化交易。

paragraphs.en: An external outcome records what happened, but does not identify the internal procedure or mechanism responsible for it. This distinction becomes consequential when a production system receives feedback while its code, artifacts, configuration, and operational rules are being revised. The system evaluated today may differ from the procedure that produced yesterday’s output.
paragraphs.zh: 外部结果记录了所发生的事件，但并未指出导致该事件发生的内部流程或机制。 当生产系统在代码、产物、配置和运行规则正在修订的同时接收到反馈时，这种区别就会产生影响。 今天评估的系统可能与昨天生成结果的流程有所不同。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench provides repository issue-resolution tasks, while SWE-agent illustrates tool-mediated repository navigation, code editing, and program execution [ 26 , 21 ] . LLM agents can participate in production engineering through such activities. Their participation raises questions about the identity of the resulting system and the authority to change or deploy it. The identity problem is not unique to LLM agents: it also arises in conventional MLOps. Here agent-assisted engineering makes tasks, tool-mediated proposals, and acceptance decisions relevant parts of the longitudinal provenance chain.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 提供了仓库问题解决的任务，而 SWE-agent 则展示了通过工具中介实现的仓库导航、代码编辑和程序执行 [ 26 , 21 ] 。 LLM 智能体可以通过此类活动参与生产工程。 它们的参与引发了关于所生成系统身份以及修改或部署该系统权限的问题。 身份问题并非 LLM 智能体所独有：传统 MLOps 中也会出现这一问题。 在此，智能体辅助工程使任务、工具中介的提案和接受决策成为纵向溯源链中的相关部分。

paragraphs.en: This paper asks: what does an external outcome actually tell us about an evolving system?
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出一个问题：一个外部结果实际上能告诉我们关于一个演化系统的什么信息？

paragraphs.en: A financial loss is a stochastic outcome, not a built-in software correctness label. Even when a portfolio performs poorly relative to an explicit reference, the observed result does not name the faulty model, the faulty line of code, the faulty training mode, or the relevant environmental mechanism. The threshold defining “failure,” the comparator, and the analysis window must themselves be specified. Reality can therefore be authoritative about what happened while remaining ambiguous about why it happened.
paragraphs.zh: 财务损失是一种随机结果，而非软件正确性的内置标签。 即使投资组合相对于明确的参照标准表现不佳，观察到的结果也无法指出有缺陷的模型、有缺陷的代码行、有缺陷的训练模式或相关的环境机制。 定义“失败”的阈值、比较器和分析窗口本身都必须被明确指定。 因此，现实可以权威地说明发生了什么，但可能对发生的原因保持模糊。

paragraphs.en: The distinction is concrete in QuantPits , an agent-engineered production ML system. Here agent-engineered means developed and revised with LLM-agent assistance under human-issued tasks, with human operational and deployment authority retained. The operator reports that LLM agents performed most engine modifications under human-issued tasks, while the operator directed or approved the route and supervised review and deployment. Agents had no independent authority to initiate changes or deploy them. Machine recommendations also passed through human execution decisions. Section 3 separates engineering, diagnosis, and trading roles.
paragraphs.zh: 在由智能体构建的生产型机器学习系统 QuantPits 中，这种区别是具体的。 此处“由智能体构建”指的是在人类下达的任务下，借助 LLM 智能体的协助进行开发与修订，同时人类保留了操作和部署的权限。 操作员报告称，在人类下达的任务下，大多数引擎修改是由 LLM 智能体执行的，而操作员则负责指导或批准方向，并监督审查与部署过程。 智能体没有独立发起变更或部署变更的权限。 机器的推荐也必须经过人类的执行决策环节。 第 3 节将工程、诊断和交易的角色进行了区分。

paragraphs.en: During 2026, the account experienced poor production performance followed by a strong rebound. An adverse-regime-and-recovery narrative might fit that trajectory, but a forensic reconstruction could not establish it. Repository and configuration records document changes during the incident, while complete per-action deployment identity had not been persisted. The archive supports outcome and selected output descriptions; it does not establish a single frozen model entering and leaving a regime.

paragraphs.en: Our earlier Out-of-Money Reinforcement Learning ( OOM-RL ) study emphasized evaluator independence : externally imposed economic consequences can constrain agent-engineered evaluation [ 1 ] . Paper II examines diagnostic resolution : those consequences do not identify their generating procedure or causal explanation. Independence here concerns an external constraint on internal evaluation narratives, not a complete correctness or alignment guarantee. The studies share some production observations, as disclosed in Section 3 ; the present question concerns the interpretation of feedback rather than replication of investment performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们早期的“无资金强化学习”（OOM-RL）研究强调了评估者的独立性：外部施加的经济后果可以限制智能体设计的评估过程 [1]。 论文 II 探讨了诊断性解决机制：这些后果无法识别其生成过程或因果解释。 此处的独立性涉及对内部评估叙述的外部约束，而非对正确性或对齐性的完全保证。 这些研究在部分生成观察结果上存在共通之处（如第 3 节所述）；当前问题关注的是反馈的解释，而非投资绩效的复现。

paragraphs.en: The external environment can evolve while the software, configuration, artifacts, or adaptation rules that generate decisions also evolve. We use dual non-stationarity descriptively to denote simultaneous evolution of the external environment and the evaluated decision procedure; we do not claim novelty for the phrase. Section 2 separates those changes formally.
paragraphs.zh: 外部环境可以演化，同时生成决策的软件、配置、成果或适应规则也会随之演化。 我们使用“双重非平稳性”这一描述性术语，指外部环境与被评估的决策程序同步演化；我们不认为该短语具有创新性。 第 2 节从形式上区分了这些变化。

paragraphs.en: This does not make prospective evaluation impossible. It requires precision about what object is being evaluated . A frozen instance, a pre-specified adaptive procedure, and an ad-hoc development process support different longitudinal claims. Finance makes the distinction consequential: outcomes are stochastic, delayed, reference-dependent, and separated from recommendations by execution constraints; the historical market cannot literally be reset for debugging. Acceptance of the systems argument does not depend on believing that the strategy produces persistent alpha.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不意味着前瞻性评估是不可能的。 它要求明确界定正在评估的具体对象。 一个冻结实例、一个预先指定的自适应程序以及一个临时开发流程，支持不同的纵向主张。 金融领域使这种区分具有实际意义：结果具有随机性、延迟性、参考依赖性，并且由于执行限制而与建议相分离；历史市场无法真正重置以进行调试。 接受系统论点并不依赖于相信该策略能产生持续的阿尔法收益。

paragraphs.en: What outcome- and output-level symptoms are supported by the available data under explicitly defined references, scopes, and horizons?
paragraphs.zh: 在明确界定的参考、范围和时限下，现有数据支持哪些结果和输出层面的症状？

paragraphs.en: Does the available evidence identify a single frozen production decision function or a unique technical root cause for the incident?
paragraphs.zh: 现有证据能否确定该事件存在单一的固化生产决策函数或独特的技术根本原因？

paragraphs.en: What provenance and identity distinctions are required for scientifically valid longitudinal claims about frozen and adaptive agent-engineered systems?
paragraphs.zh: 对于关于冻结型和自适应型智能体工程系统的纵向研究，若要具备科学有效性，需要做出哪些来源和身份上的区分？

paragraphs.en: A longitudinal case with archive-bounded diagnostic findings. We report one year of live account performance, a retrospectively identified incident, and conditional candidate-level and reference-relative symptoms. paragraphs.en: An evaluated-object identity and evidence framework. paragraphs.en: Recommendations were generated from information available after the preceding market close; the date in an order filename denotes intended execution, not the availability of that day’s prices. At the intended day’s open, the operator sold designated positions in full and allocated remaining cash approximately equally across selected buys. Buys were in integer lots of 100 shares. A candidate inventory approximately three times the primary selection count supported substitutions when a stock could not be bought. Opening tradability, including suspension and limit-state judgments, was determined manually; these judgments were unavailable when recommendations were generated. paragraphs.en: The paper uses the CSI300 index as one broad benchmark and an idealized equal-weight reference over the CSI300-related stock subset as an additional cross-sectional context. The latter is not described as an executable trading strategy. The subset follows system-specific eligibility rules and is not the full CSI300 universe. The reference uses prior-trading-day membership, recorded delisting exclusions, and daily ideal gross rebalancing. It carries forward the last available positive adjusted close for missing prices, without backward filling from future observations. A carried suspension price contributes zero price return until a new quote is available, when the price change is recognized. This is a valuation convention, not an assertion of tradability. We therefore refer to it as an approximate equal-weight reference . Annual reference return is − 5.1523 -5.1523 %; all 241 return dates are covered, with carried endpoints on 66 dates. paragraphs.en: RQ1 finding. The data support limited, explicitly conditioned output-level symptoms rather than a universal “Buy-signal failure.” April and June show negative T+10 candidate-relative outcomes under the signal-close, approximate equal-weight reference; 272 of 5,000 approximate random-ranking paths (5.44%) have June returns at or below the observed account return under the stated reference mechanics. paragraphs.zh: RQ1 的发现。 数据仅支持有限且明确受条件约束的输出层面症状，而非普遍的“买入信号失效”。在信号关闭、近似等权参考机制下，四月和六月显示出负面的 T+10 候选相对结果；在 5,000 条近似随机排序路径中，有 272 条（5.44%）的六月回报低于或等于既定参考机制下的账户实际回报。 其他时间范围、候选层级、卖出观察结果和队列分解的结果则混杂不一。 次要诊断方法限定了特定叙述的范围以及后续需要研究的问题；但它们并未确立独立于市场条件或生产堆栈变化的原因。

paragraphs.en: For this case, a practical starting point is a resolvable relation: recommendation ID to run/instance ID to immutable procedure, configuration, artifact, and input references. Separate the engineering-task lineage described in Section 3 from generation-time prompt or agent-trace identities when those components actually affect the output.

sents.en: Persist generation time and an output digest alongside content-backed snapshots captured during that run.

paragraphs.zh: 将已执行操作/填写 ID 分别与推荐、替换或明确的未关联状态分开关联。 这保留了机器提案与影响账户结算的操作之间的区别。 缺失的绑定必须保持不可用，而不是通过可变的最新指针进行事后填充。 这些链接使参照物可以被解析；声明级别仍然取决于参考设计、遥测/比较以及因果识别（第 2.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Freeze relevant code, configuration, and artifacts before evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估前，请冻结相关的代码、配置和成果。

paragraphs.en: Bind each action to the instance and execution-time inputs; separate recommendations and executed actions.
paragraphs.zh: 将每个动作与实例和执行时的输入绑定；将推荐项与已执行的动作分开。

paragraphs.en: End the instance-specific record at material change and explicitly handle horizons spanning that change.
paragraphs.zh: 在材料发生变化时结束实例特定的记录，并显式处理跨越该变化的时间范围。

paragraphs.en: Specify adaptation/retraining, information timing, and allowed state-update channels before future outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 在预测未来结果之前，请明确指定适应/重新训练、信息时机以及允许的状态更新通道。

paragraphs.en: Persist procedure ID and each realized state/artifact/input snapshot.
paragraphs.zh: 持久化过程 ID 以及每个已实现的状态/产物/输入快照。

paragraphs.en: Continue a procedure-level prequential record across allowed updates.
paragraphs.zh: 在允许的更新中继续维护过程级别的预序记录。

paragraphs.en: Declare a new procedure-level boundary for discretionary rule revisions; preserve earlier evidence under its original object.
paragraphs.zh: 为裁量性规则修订声明一个新的过程级边界；在其原始对象下保留先前的证据。

paragraphs.en: Record the direct outcome without automatically labeling it as an internal fault.
paragraphs.zh: 记录直接结果，而不要自动将其标记为内部故障。

paragraphs.en: Declare comparator, anchor, horizon, and scope; label retrospective selections.
paragraphs.zh: 声明比较器、锚点、时间范围和作用域；为回顾性选择添加标签。

paragraphs.en: Resolve which procedure/state generated recommendations and executed actions; list unresolved archive-compatible alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 确定哪个程序/状态生成了推荐并执行了操作；列出未解决的与存档兼容的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Use telemetry/comparison for subsystem claims and intervention or justified counterfactual design for causal claims.
paragraphs.zh: 对于子系统的断言，请使用遥测/比较方法；对于因果性断言，请使用干预或合理的反事实设计。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 finding. Frozen-instance, adaptive-procedure, and execution-state claims need distinct identity bindings. Pre-specified adaptation permits a continuing prospective record; ad-hoc rule changes create new boundaries. Resolvable recommendation-to-runtime and action-to-recommendation links are a practical first priority, not an automatic increase in claim level. Provenance constrains compatible referents, while reference design and causal identification determine how far outcomes support diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 的发现。 冻结实例、自适应程序和运行状态的主张需要不同的身份绑定。 预先指定的适应允许持续的向前记录；临时规则变更会创建新的边界。 可解析的推荐到运行时以及动作到推荐的关联是实际的第一优先事项，而非主张级别的自动提升。 来源信息约束了兼容的指代对象，而参考设计和因果识别则决定了结果在多大程度上支持诊断。

sents.en: RQ3 finding.
sents.zh: RQ3 的发现。

sents.en: Frozen-instance, adaptive-procedure, and execution-state claims need distinct identity bindings.

paragraphs.en: An external outcome constrains what can be claimed about the realized account path. It does not supply a test assertion naming a violated internal invariant. Financial outcomes are stochastic, reference-dependent, and path-dependent. This separates the value of reality-grounded feedback from its causal resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 外部结果限制了对已实现账户路径所能做出的主张。 它并未提供一个测试断言来指明被违反的内部不变量。 财务结果是随机的、参照依赖的且路径依赖的。 这使基于现实的反馈的价值与其因果解决相分离。

paragraphs.en: Software testing already recognizes the oracle problem and the separation between terminal correctness information and fault localization [ 2 , 3 ] . The present case adds an evolving-system complication: even if the external outcome is accepted as informative, the identity of the evaluated program may itself be moving.
paragraphs.zh: 软件测试早已认识到“神谕问题”以及终端正确性信息与故障定位之间的分离 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 当前案例增加了一个动态系统的复杂因素：即使外部结果被接受为具有信息价值，所评估程序的身份本身也可能在变化。

paragraphs.en: In the present analysis, the small account’s historical market-price path is treated as approximately given. This modeling choice does not eliminate order-dependent execution effects or the action-dependent evolution of inventory and cash. In other settings, decisions can also change subsequent data distributions, rewards, or state transitions, as studied in performative prediction and reinforcement learning [ 23 , 24 ] . Those feedback paths add issues for an identification design to address; this case neither measures their size nor establishes a quantitative amplification law.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前分析中，小账户的历史市场价格路径被视为近似给定的。 这种建模选择并未消除与订单相关的执行效应，也未消除与操作相关的库存和现金变化。 在其他情境中，决策也可能改变后续的数据分布、奖励或状态转移，正如表演性预测和强化学习中所研究的那样 [ 23 , 24 ] 。 这些反馈路径为识别设计带来了需要解决的问题；而本案例既未衡量其规模，也未建立定量的放大规律。

paragraphs.en: Temporal credit assignment studies how delayed consequences should be associated with previous actions [ 4 ] . In a production software/ML stack, the targets of attribution can include models, fitted artifacts, training windows, data paths, ensemble rules, execution decisions, and human overrides. We use system-level diagnostic credit assignment as a descriptive phrase for this enlarged attribution problem, not as a replacement for established RL terminology.
paragraphs.zh: 时间信用分配研究的是延迟的后果应如何与先前的行动相关联 [ 4 ] 。 在生产软件/机器学习堆栈中，归因的目标可以包括模型、已拟合的产物、训练窗口、数据路径、集成规则、执行决策以及人工覆盖。 我们将系统级诊断信用分配用作这一扩展归因问题的描述性短语，而非用来替代现有的强化学习术语。

paragraphs.en: Sculley et al. describe production ML as vulnerable to entanglement, hidden feedback loops, data dependencies, configuration issues, and changes in the external world [ 7 ] . The QuantPits incident is consistent with that systems view: the behavior of a deployed pipeline cannot be reduced to a model coefficient vector. A performance record detached from the identity and lineage of the surrounding stack may answer an organization-level question while failing to answer a model-level one.
paragraphs.zh: Sculley 等人指出，生产环境中的机器学习系统容易受到纠缠、隐藏反馈循环、数据依赖关系、配置问题以及外部世界变化的影响 [ 7 ]。 QuantPits 事件与该系统视角一致：已部署的流程行为无法简化为一个模型系数向量。 脱离周围堆栈身份和来源的性能记录，或许能回答组织层面的问题，却无法回答模型层面的问题。

paragraphs.en: W3C PROV provides a general vocabulary for entities, activities, agents, and derivations [ 8 ] ; PROV-AGENT extends provenance toward agent-centric prompts, responses, and decisions [ 9 ] . A resolved provenance relation can establish the referent of an outcome claim: the procedure, artifact, data state, and action being analyzed. Causal interpretation then requires comparison and identification structure beyond that binding.
paragraphs.zh: W3C PROV 为实体、活动、智能体和派生关系提供了一套通用词汇表 [ 8 ]；PROV-AGENT 则将溯源信息扩展至以智能体为中心的问题、响应和决策 [ 9 ]。 一个已解析的溯源关系可以确定某个结果主张的指代对象：即正在被分析的程序、产物、数据状态和行动。 随后，因果解释需要借助超越这种绑定关系的比较与识别结构。

paragraphs.en: Without that binding, causal analysis may be asking the wrong question about the wrong system.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有这种约束，因果分析可能会针对错误的系统提出错误的问题。

paragraphs.en: AIOpsLab represents a complementary regime: controlled environments, injected faults, generated workloads, and telemetry for evaluating incident-management agents [ 10 ] . Control over fault generation supplies known experimental structure for diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: AIOpsLab 代表一种互补机制：受控环境、注入的故障、生成的工作负载以及用于评估事件管理智能体的遥测数据 [ 10 ]。 对故障生成的控制为诊断提供了已知的实验结构。

sents.en: AIOpsLab represents a complementary regime: controlled environments, injected faults, generated workloads, and telemetry for evaluating incident-management agents [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: AIOpsLab 代表一种互补机制：受控环境、注入的故障、生成的工作负载以及用于评估事件管理智能体的遥测数据 [ 10 ]。

sents.en: Control over fault generation supplies known experimental structure for diagnosis.
sents.zh: 对故障生成的控制为诊断提供了已知的实验结构。

paragraphs.en: Naturally occurring cloud incidents offer a further comparison: RCACopilot aggregates runtime information and produces root-cause categories and explanatory narratives [ 28 ] . Its incident records and operational labels provide diagnostic evidence that our market case does not inherit; a category prediction is not by itself an identified causal mechanism. The present case trades controlled clarity for ecological validity. The market cannot be reset; failures are naturally occurring; action consequences are entangled with the environment; and the system was being modified during deployment. The lesson is not that live evidence is superior to controlled benchmarks, but that causal certainty from controlled benchmarks should not be projected onto uncontrolled longitudinal production data.
paragraphs.zh: 自然发生的云环境事件提供了进一步的比较：RCACopilot 会汇总运行时信息，并生成根本原因类别和解释性叙述 [ 28 ]。 其事件记录和操作标签提供了诊断证据，而这些证据并非我们的市场案例所继承；仅凭一个类别预测本身并不能构成已识别的因果机制。 当前案例以生态效度为代价，换取了受控环境下的清晰度。 市场环境无法重置；故障是自然发生的；行动后果与环境相互交织；并且系统在部署过程中正被修改。 这一经验教训并非说明实时证据优于受控基准测试，而是指出不应将来自受控基准测试的因果确定性投射到未经控制的纵向生产数据中。

paragraphs.en: The same evidentiary discipline applies to favorable and unfavorable outcomes. The selected July–September segment returns +15.2461% over 65 observations; the single-market annualized intercept is +76.5417% ( p = 0.00230 p=0.00230 ), and the multi-proxy intercept is +53.3570% ( p = 0.00793 p=0.00793 ). These are retrospective, specification-dependent estimates. July and August improved, while September was negative; candidate results also vary by horizon and class. Incomplete runtime identity prevents the archive from establishing that the same frozen model recovered or that a particular intervention repaired it.
paragraphs.zh: 相同的证据纪律同样适用于有利和不利结果。 所选的 7 月至 9 月时段在 65 次观察中实现了 +15.2461% 的回报；单一市场的年化截距为 +76.5417%（p = 0.00230 p=0.00230），而多代理截距为 +53.3570%（p = 0.00793 p=0.00793）。 这些是回顾性的、依赖于模型设定的估计值。 7 月和 8 月表现改善，而 9 月则为负值；候选结果也因时间范围和类别而异。 运行时的身份不完整，导致档案无法确认恢复的是同一个冻结模型，也无法确认特定干预措施是否修复了该模型。

paragraphs.en: Improvement can reduce the perceived urgency of investigation, but it should not substitute for resolving the original diagnostic questions. Work on automation-related complacency and bias provides a broader reason to attend to oversight of imperfect automated aids [ 25 ] ; we did not measure those psychological effects or show that this operator stopped investigating. The prospective recommendation is to record what identity and comparative evidence supports closure, and which hypotheses remain open. Good outcomes can leave the same identity and causal questions unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 改进可以降低调查的感知紧迫性，但它不应取代对原始诊断问题的解决。 关于自动化相关自满和偏见的研究，为关注不完美的自动化辅助工具的监督提供了更广泛的原因 [ 25 ]；我们并未测量这些心理效应，也未证明该操作员停止了调查。 前瞻性的建议是记录哪些身份和比较证据支持了结论的达成，以及哪些假设仍然悬而未决。 良好的结果也可能使相同的身份和因果问题得不到解决。

paragraphs.en: The June approximate random reference is still useful because it answers a limited descriptive question: where did the observed production result sit relative to uninformed selection under an approximate common portfolio rule? It does not need to be a strict hypothesis test to provide context.
paragraphs.zh: 六月的近似随机参考仍然有用，因为它回答了一个有限的描述性问题：在近似共同投资组合规则下，观测到的产出结果相对于无信息选择处于什么位置？ 它无需成为严格的假设检验来提供背景。

paragraphs.en: The annual approximate reference is equally important. paragraphs.en: SWE-bench evaluates issue-driven repository changes, and SWE-agent supplies interfaces for repository navigation, editing, and program execution [ 26 , 21 ] . Our longitudinal question adds runtime identity, human acceptance, and action binding to this task-level view of engineering. In this case, tasks, direction, and deployment oversight remained human-controlled. Human–automation research discusses complacency and bias in the use of imperfect aids [ 25 ] ; it motivates an oversight question, not a diagnosis of the operator’s psychology.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 评估以问题为导向的仓库变更，而 SWE-agent 提供了用于仓库导航、编辑和程序执行的接口 [ 26 , 21 ] 。 我们的纵向研究问题在这一任务层面的工程视角中加入了运行时身份、人类接受度和行动绑定。 在这种情况下，任务、方向和实施监督仍由人类控制。 人类与自动化相关的研究探讨了使用不完美的辅助工具时产生的自满和偏见 [ 25 ] ；这引发了一个关于监督的问题，而非对操作者心理的诊断。

paragraphs.en: Test-oracle research compares behavior with an acceptance specification [ 2 ] . Our focus is the identity of the evaluated object when a deployed procedure evolves and historical stochastic conditions cannot literally be rerun.
paragraphs.zh: 测试预言家研究将行为与接受规范进行比较 [ 2 ] 。 Delta 调试通过重复测试来隔离导致故障的输入 [ 15 ]；外部预言家定位则使用反事实执行 [ 3]。 这些方法将终端反馈与其原因分离开来。 我们的关注点是，当已部署的程序发生演变且历史随机条件无法真正重运行时，被评估对象的身份问题。

paragraphs.en: JustDiag tracks evidence, findings, competing hypotheses, conflicts, and next checks, separating answer quality from process quality [ 19 ] . The present case complements this process view by asking how action-to-runtime identity bounds acceptance of a longitudinal diagnostic claim.
paragraphs.zh: JustDiag 会追踪证据、发现结果、相互竞争假设、冲突以及后续检查，并将答案质量与过程质量区分开来 [ 19 ]。 当前案例通过探讨“行动到运行时”的身份边界如何影响纵向诊断主张的接受度，补充了这一过程视角。

Our diagnostic targets also include code, artifacts, ensemble policies, and human execution. The target here is identity-bound system attribution in longitudinal production.

paragraphs.en: Dawid’s prequential view permits sequential assessment through observations arriving after prediction [ 5 ] . Concept-drift work studies adaptation and evaluation when predictive relationships change [ 16 ] . Neither parameter variation nor adaptation alone invalidates prospective evaluation. We distinguish state evolution under a declared procedure from discretionary procedure revision and show why that distinction needs runtime binding.
paragraphs.zh: Dawid 的预序观点允许通过预测后到达的观察结果进行顺序评估 [ 5 ]。 概念漂移相关研究探讨了在预测关系发生变化时的适应与评估问题 [ 16 ]。 仅参数变化或仅适应性调整本身并不会使前瞻性评估失效。 我们将既定程序下的状态演化与任意程序修订区分开来，并说明了为何这种区分需要运行时绑定。

paragraphs.en: Observability addresses detection, diagnosis, and reaction across pipelines with silent failures [ 6 ] . Data cascades describe downstream effects of upstream practices that may be delayed or difficult to observe [ 17 ] . These motivate pipeline diagnosis. We ask which versioned scientific object a changed production metric evaluates.

paragraphs.en: ModelDB tracks and queries models/pipelines across iterative development [ 18 ] . PROV-DM represents general provenance and PROV-AGENT traces agent interactions [ 8 , 9 ] . Its focus is engineering-step control; our proposed binding links recommendations to runtime identities and subsequent realized actions. These registries and lineage standards provide context for the proposed manifest, which connects procedure/artifact lineage to information timing, substitutions, and realized actions so that outcome claims have an explicit referent.
paragraphs.zh: ModelDB 可追踪和查询迭代开发过程中的模型/流程 [ 18 ]。 PROV-DM 表示通用来源信息，而 PROV-AGENT 则记录智能体间的交互 [ 8 , 9 ]。 TraceCaps 提出面向智能体软件工程的步骤级来源信息胶囊和嵌入式风险控制机制，并已有初步演示 [ 27 ]。 其重点在于工程步骤的控制；我们提出的绑定机制将推荐与运行时身份及后续的实际操作关联起来。 这些注册表和谱系标准为所提出的清单提供了上下文：该清单将流程/工件的谱系与信息的时间性、替换以及实际操作相连接，从而使结果主张具有明确的参照对象。

paragraphs.en: AIOpsLab integrates cloud environments, injected faults, workloads, telemetry, and interfaces for evaluating incident-management agents [ 10 ] . This is a complementary setting, not evidence that live observation is superior or all benchmarks are perfectly controlled.
paragraphs.zh: AIOpsLab 整合了云环境、注入的故障、工作负载、遥测数据和接口，用于评估事件管理智能体 [ 10 ] 。 已知的故障生成结构有助于评估。 RCACopilot 则通过利用运行时信息和操作根因类别，研究自然发生的云事件 [ 28 ] 。 我们的案例既缺乏实验者提供的根因标签和等效的带标签事件语料库，也缺乏可重置的市场路径。 这是一种补充性的设置，而非证明实时观察更优或所有基准测试都受到完美控制的证据。

paragraphs.en: Statistical fault localization also faces confounding: Baah et al. use causal modeling to distinguish execution associations from effects under explicit assumptions [ 29 ] . Causal inference requires identification assumptions beyond association [ 12 ] . Knowing what ran resolves identity, not its causal effect. The compatible-history criterion organizes this distinction rather than providing a new causal estimator.
paragraphs.zh: 统计故障定位也面临混淆问题：Baah 等人利用因果建模，在明确假设下区分执行关联与影响 [ 29 ] 。 因果推断需要超越关联的识别假设 [ 12 ] 。 了解哪些程序已运行可以确定身份，但无法确定其因果效应。 兼容历史标准用于组织这种区分，而非提供新的因果估计方法。

paragraphs.en: The subset-EW reference is gross and idealized, with membership, delisting, and carried-price conventions; candidate-relative results use signal-close matching only. Opening replays and random references simplify manual tradability judgments, substitutions, integer lots, cash allocation, and fees, including minimum-fee mechanics and small cash imbalances. The random reference follows a five-trading-day schedule on a continuous annual path before slicing June. Fixed-basket and account-linked contributions answer different accounting questions, and neither is FIFO realized P&L. These constructions support scoped comparisons rather than exact alternate histories or root-cause probabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 子集-EW参考是粗略且理想化的，包含成员资格、除名和携带价格等惯例；候选相对结果仅使用信号收盘价匹配。 开盘重演和随机参考简化了手动交易判断、替代、整数手数、现金分配和费用（包括最低费用机制和小额现金失衡）。 随机参考遵循一个连续年度路径上的五个交易日时间表，之后在六月进行切片。 固定篮子贡献和账户关联贡献回答了不同的会计问题，且两者都不是先进先出实现的利润与亏损。 这些构建支持范围限定的比较，而非精确的替代历史或根本原因概率。

paragraphs.en: Regression inference depends on the stated covariance, risk-free-rate, and explanatory-variable specifications. HAC(3) is a retrospective presentation convention, with OLS, HAC(5), and HAC(10) sensitivities retained; the style proxies are not canonical pricing factors. Significance levels do not determine which specification is retained. Repeated candidate occurrences and overlapping horizons are not independent samples, and regression HAC does not calibrate their descriptive summaries. Right-censoring at the cutoff requires observed coverage to be reported rather than assumed complete.
paragraphs.zh: 回归推断取决于所声明的协方差、无风险利率以及解释变量的设定。 HAC(3) 是一种回顾性呈现惯例，其中保留了 OLS、HAC(5) 和 HAC(10) 的敏感性；这些风格代理并非标准定价因子。 显著性水平并不决定保留哪一种设定。 重复出现的候选项和重叠的时间范围并非独立样本，回归 HAC 也不会校准其描述性摘要。 在截断点处进行右删失时，必须报告实际观察到的覆盖情况，而非假设其完整。

paragraphs.en: This is one system and one domain. Agent-assisted implementation and human authority are operator-reported and partly illustrated by notes, rather than quantified through authorship, modification speed, or oversight measures. Finance supplies stochastic outcomes, delayed attribution, execution constraints, and a historical path that cannot be reset; other settings may offer controlled replay or decision-induced environmental feedback. The case does not estimate that feedback or establish population-level magnitudes or a complexity-growth law. The proposed production-binding protocol was not historically implemented in full and is not prospectively validated by this case; its diagnostic benefits remain to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个单一系统和单一领域。 智能体辅助实施与人类权威由操作员报告，并通过注释部分说明，而非通过作者归属、修改速度或监督措施进行量化。 金融领域提供随机结果、延迟的归因、执行限制以及无法重置的历史路径；其他设置可能提供受控的重演或由决策引发的环境反馈。 该案例并未估算这种反馈，也未确定群体层面的规模或复杂性增长规律。 所提出的生产绑定协议在历史上并未完全实施，且在本案例中未得到前瞻性验证；其诊断效益仍有待评估。

paragraphs.en: The QuantPits case separates realized outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal diagnosis. Across the fixed-for-analysis 2025-10-01–2026-09-30 annual window, the account gained and outperformed CSI300, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification. Selected subperiods include severe adverse relative performance and strong later outcomes. Candidate and random-reference diagnostics provide conditional descriptions under declared scopes; style, cohort, and replay analyses constrain specific narratives.
paragraphs.zh: QuantPits 案例区分了已实现结果证据、评估对象的身份以及因果诊断。 在固定用于分析的 2025-10-01–2026-09-30 年度窗口期内，该账户的收益超过了 CSI300，但在主要回顾性设定下，其年度阿尔法值在统计上无法与零区分。 选定的子周期包括严重的相对表现不佳以及后期的强劲表现。 候选诊断和随机参考诊断在声明的范围内提供了条件描述；风格、队列和重播分析则对特定的叙述进行了限制。

paragraphs.en: Engineering/configuration changes overlap the episode, but complete historical action-to-runtime binding is unavailable. The archive therefore supports an evolving account record rather than establishing one frozen instance or a unique cause. The later gains do not establish recovery of the same model. This outcome–diagnosis gap concerns both the referent and the explanation of feedback, complementing Paper I’s emphasis on external evaluation constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 工程/配置变更与事件周期重叠，但无法获取完整的从历史动作到运行时绑定的对应关系。 因此，该存档支持一个不断演变的记录，而非确立某个固定不变的状态或单一原因。 后期的收益并不能证明同一模型已恢复。 这种结果与诊断之间的差距既涉及反馈的参照对象，也涉及其解释，从而补充了论文 I 对外部评估约束的强调。

paragraphs.en: For longitudinal evaluation, the first task is to make the outcome’s referent resolvable. Frozen-instance claims require material identity binding; a pre-specified adaptive procedure can maintain its prospective record across declared state updates. Separate links from recommendations to runtime artifacts and from recommendations to executed actions preserve these distinctions.

paragraphs.en: The swap diagnostic forms unique-stock baskets from same-day actual Buy and Sell fills. Within each side it takes the equal-weight mean stock return from execution-day open to the shared horizon close, then subtracts Sell from Buy. Monthly summaries are medians of these batch differences; the positive fraction counts batches with positive differences. It is not a one-to-one matched-trade design, not realized P&L, and does not isolate opportunity cost or manual execution effects.
paragraphs.zh: 该交换诊断方法利用同一天的实际买入和卖出成交数据，形成独特的股票组合。 在每一侧中，它计算从执行日开盘到共享时间范围收盘的等权重平均股票回报，然后用买入回报减去卖出回报。 月度摘要为这些批次差异的中位数；正数比例表示差异为正的批次数量。 这并非一对一匹配交易设计，也不是已实现的损益计算，且无法单独区分机会成本或手动执行的影响。

paragraphs.en: Cohorts are fixed at the 29 May holding snapshot. Labels reflect the start of the stock’s uninterrupted positive-holding episode in snapshots available by that date, not FIFO acquisition lots; episodes already present at the beginning of the available archive are left-censored. A fixed-basket contribution uses 29 May equity-value weights, excluding cash, and holds adjusted units fixed through 30 June. It is not the actual June NAV decomposition. Under that construction, the May-entry basket has a median June return of − 8.0756 -8.0756 %, a mean of − 10.0925 -10.0925 %, and a fixed-basket contribution of − 4.8413 -4.8413 pp.
paragraphs.zh: 队列以 5 月 29 日的持仓快照为固定基准。 标签反映的是截至该日期可用的快照中，股票连续正向持仓阶段的起始点，而非先进先出（FIFO）的买入批次；在可用历史数据初始阶段即已存在的持仓阶段则被视为左截断数据。 固定组合贡献度采用 5 月 29 日的权益价值权重（不含现金），并在 6 月 30 日前保持调整后的单位数量不变。 这并非实际的六月净资产价值（NAV）分解结果。 在此构建方式下，五月入池的组合在六月的中位回报率为 −8.0756%，平均回报率为 −10.0925%，固定组合贡献度为 −4.8413 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The replay initializes the 22 actual holdings and cash at the 2 March close and trades only on subsequent recorded recommendation dates through 30 June. Position counts can decline if replacement buys cannot be filled. The opening-gap proxy blocks buys in either direction at an absolute adjusted open/previous-close gap of at least 9.5%, and sells at a downward gap of at least 9.5%; it is not historical exchange limit metadata. Recommended held-stock exits are prioritized; when a larger DropN needs additional exits, a deterministic instrument-order heuristic selects held stocks outside the Buy list. This does not reconstruct a complete historical score ranking. Buy budgets are approximately equal across available slots; fees are reserved before rounding down to whole lots, and unfilled slots retain cash. Initial adjusted units remain fixed between trades, cash earns no interest, and no external funding is added.

paragraphs.en: We use the engine’s pure numerical TopK Dropout random-ranking function with K = 22 K=22 and Drop0/3/22, generating 5,000 continuous annual paths per profile with seed 20261001. Profiles share each trial’s uniform random scores. Every five trading days, scores rank the prior-day eligible subset; Drop3 removes low-ranked holdings and replenishes from eligible candidates, with forced exits for out-of-pool holdings on rebalance dates. June is sliced from the annual paths rather than restarted at actual June holdings. Daily returns are ideal equal-weight means even between scheduled constituent changes, using historical carried-price valuation as in the approximate EW reference. Suspended stocks can consequently enter simulations despite being non-executable. After initialization, the new-buy count divided by K K is multiplied by the combined configured buy/sell rate (0.002) and deducted on rebalance dates. No initial fee, minimum fee, whole-lot, opening-fill, or manual-override mechanics are modeled. These simplifications define an approximate random reference rather than a matched production null.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用引擎的纯数值 TopK Dropout 随机排序函数，其中 K = 22，并采用 Drop0/3/22 设置，以种子值 20261001 为每个配置文件生成 5,000 条连续的年度路径。 各配置文件共享每次试验中的均匀随机得分。 每五个交易日，系统会根据得分对前一交易日符合条件的资产子集进行排序；Drop3 会移除排名靠后的持仓，并从符合条件的候选池中补充新持仓，同时在再平衡日强制清退不在池中的持仓。 年度路径中的六月数据会被直接截取，而非从实际的六月持仓重新开始。 即使是在计划调整成分资产期间，每日回报也被视为理想化的等权重均值，并使用近似 EW 参考方法中的历史持仓价格进行估值。 因此，尽管暂停交易的股票无法执行交易，它们仍可能进入模拟过程。 初始化之后，新买入数量除以 K 的结果会乘以预设的买卖综合比率（0.002），并在再平衡日进行扣除。 模型中未包含初始费用、最低费用、整手交易、开盘成交或手动覆盖等机制。 这些简化设定定义了一个近似的随机参考基准，而非与实际生产环境完全匹配的零假设基准。

sents.zh: 即使是在计划调整成分资产期间，每日回报也被视为理想化的等权重均值，并使用近似 EW 参考方法中的历史持仓价格进行估值。

sents.en: Suspended stocks can consequently enter simulations despite being non-executable.
sents.zh: 因此，尽管暂停交易的股票无法执行交易，它们仍可能进入模拟过程。

sents.en: After initialization, the new-buy count divided by K K is multiplied by the combined configured buy/sell rate (0.002) and deducted on rebalance dates.
sents.zh: 初始化之后，新买入数量除以 K 的结果会乘以预设的买卖综合比率（0.002），并在再平衡日进行扣除。

sents.en: No initial fee, minimum fee, whole-lot, opening-fill, or manual-override mechanics are modeled.
sents.zh: 模型中未包含初始费用、最低费用、整手交易、开盘成交或手动覆盖等机制。

sents.en: These simplifications define an approximate random reference rather than a matched production null.

paragraphs.en: Multi-factor sensitivity adds three lagged cross-sectional long–short proxies to market excess return: log adjusted-price times volume, 20-trading-day momentum, and 20-trading-day return volatility (minimum five observations). Each characteristic is lagged one trading day, with a 45-calendar-day buffer before the first analyzed day. On each day’s prior-day subset members, the common complete observed cross-section is used without filling stock prices; each factor is the mean current-day return at or above its characteristic’s 80th percentile minus the mean at or below its 20th percentile. At least five complete stocks are required. These are engine-inspired liquidity, momentum, and volatility proxies, not canonical Fama–French, Barra, or industry-neutral factors. Annual, initial, incident-background, and later regressions use 241, 94, 82, and 65 days, respectively, under the same covariance/risk-free conventions. The reconstructed definition differs from the legacy production factor implementation; this sensitivity is documented in the local research archive.
paragraphs.zh: 多因素敏感性分析向市场超额收益加入了三个滞后横截面多空代理变量：对数调整价格乘以成交量、20个交易日动量以及20个交易日收益波动率（至少五个观测值）。 每个特征均滞后一个交易日，并在首个分析日之前保留45个日历日的缓冲期。 对于每日前一日子集中的成员，使用共同的完整观测横截面数据，无需填充股价；每个因素等于当前收益在特征第80百分位点及以上水平的均值减去其在第20百分位点及以下水平的均值。 至少需要五个完整的股票样本。 这些是源自引擎设计的流动性、动量和波动率代理变量，而非标准的法玛-弗伦奇、Barra或行业中性因素。 年度、初始、事件背景及后续回归分别使用241天、94天、82天和65天，并遵循相同的协方差/无风险利率约定。 重构后的定义与旧版生产环境中的因素实现存在差异；该敏感性分析已记录在本地研究档案中。

paragraphs.en: S1 summarizes operator-maintained system records, excluding outside-system funds. It supports inspection of account paths and holding-set evolution, not independent brokerage certification or reproduction of every diagnostic table. Stable aliases do not guarantee anonymity.
